answer_1.quote: Paraphrase generation aims to generate alternative surface forms expressing the same semantic content as the original text

answer_2.quote: we use BLEU(c, r) as a measure of fidelity, and BLEU(c, s)-known as self-BLEU-as a measure of diversity. ... we also report iBLEU = α BLEU -(1-α) self-BLEU

answer_4.quote: we carried out a human evaluation through Amazon Mechanical Turk
answer_4.guideline: We then ask human evaluators to compare the two sentences according to three criteria: diversity, fidelity and fluency
